convention: Blocks, local to each room: x from its west wall, z from its north wall, y above its floor. r is the facing in degrees: 0 faces +z (south), 90 faces +x (east). Runs tile a wall prop from a to b along wall N, S, W or E. Rooms marked nominal have a plan size but no position yet. Depot 7: plans no longer carry doorDouble, sash, stairFlight or newelPost (the Estate builds its own). A small item standing on furniture carries on: the index in this room's items of the table it sits on.
